protocol.MPT_precision: BF16 autocast; FP32 conditioning and sparse aggregation
protocol.BP_precision: Native LDPC double precision sum-product, independent per-block early stop, max200 parallel schedule, one thread per worker
protocol.postprocess: Identical signed zero-centered prior-scored CS8, always executed, shortcutsFalse
protocol.clock: Warm synchronous batch service time, host inputs to all host recovery vectors. Includes feature construction, H2D/D2H, process task/result IPC and CS8. Model/graph construction, worker startup, JIT compilation, warmup, evaluation checks, and waiting to accumulate batch excluded.
protocol.paired_execution: Shared same-size CPU pool; order of methods randomized per batch. No overlapping batches or hidden GPU/CPU pipelines.
